Senior Frontend Engineer (React)

About the project:
We build a B2B analytics platform used by 2,000 companies. Our stack is Node.js on the backend and React on the frontend.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of commercial experience with JavaScript and TypeScript
- Deep knowledge of React (hooks, context) and Redux Toolkit
- Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, CSS Grid
- Experience with REST APIs and GraphQL
- Unit testing with Jest and React Testing Library
- Git, code review culture, CI/CD
- Upper-Intermediate English

Nice to have:
- Next.js
- Experience with Docker and AWS
- Web accessibility (WCAG)

Responsibilities:
- Rest of the team relies on you to react quickly to production incidents.
- Promise to keep the stack modern and go the extra mile.
